topic: What power allocation trade-offs arise from differing scan losses between quasi-TEM and quasi-TE1 modes for multi-beam satellite systems?
consensus_response: The differing scan losses between quasi-TEM and quasi-TE1 modes for multi-beam satellite systems introduce power allocation trade-offs. Quasi-TEM modes have lower scan losses and more efficient power use due to smaller array factors, while quasi-TE1 modes have larger array factors, leading to increased scan loss and reduced power efficiency. This results in increased interference in quasi-TE1 modes, necessitating more aggressive power allocation strategies to compensate. The system's capacity is reduced due to the increased interference, highlighting the need for careful power allocation trade-offs to balance capacity and interference.
